title: A gas–liquid switching reaction system for normothermic photo-driven chemical looping ammonia synthesis
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EE00524A, Paper
Yunfan He, Lulu Zhang, Fangfang Li, Jianxin Liu, Rui Li, Jiancheng Wang
A gas–liquid switching reaction system (GLS) enabling metal oxides to drive photo-driven CLAS under ambient conditions, achieving an NH3 production rate of 1.48 mmol g−1 h−1 on TiO2 via alternating N2/H2O coverage for green NH3 synthesis.
